changed.title: A fixed interval of alternating mixed sites attains the adaptive optimum for growing query budgets on a singular column bank
changed.statement:
∀ (t : ℕ) (ht : 0 < t) (h : ℕ), 1 ≤ h → 100*(h+4)^2 ≤ t →
  letI : ∀ p : Prop, Decidable p := Classical.propDecidable
  let F := ZMod 2
  let n := 6*t
  let W := Fin n → F
  let ix := fun j : ℕ => (⟨j % n, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.zero_lt_succ 5) ht)⟩ : Fin n)
  let rot := fun (s : ℕ) (w : W) (i : Fin n) => w (ix (i.val + n - s % n))
  let out := fun (name c raw : W) (i : Fin n) =>
    let old := rot 3 raw + name
    let y := fun j : Fin n => old j + old (ix (j.val+2)) + old (ix (j.val+n-2))
    y i + (1+y (ix (i.val+1)))*y (ix (i.val+2)) + rot 4 raw i + c i
  let run := fun (ask : Fin h → ℕ → W →ₗ[F] F) (w : W) =>
    (List.finRange h).foldl (fun z i => 2*z + (if ask i z w = 0 then 0 else 1)) (0 : ℕ)
  let mix := fun (w : W) (i : Fin n) =>
    let old := rot 3 w
    old i + old (ix (i.val+2)) + old (ix (i.val+n-2))
  let zeros := Nat.card {w : W //
    (∀ j : Fin h, mix w (ix (2*j.val)) = 0) ∧ (∀ i, mix w i * mix w (ix (i.val+1)) = 0)}
  ∀ (name c : W) (fixed : Bool) (k : ℕ),
    (∃ (ask : Fin h → ℕ → W →ₗ[F] F) (A : ℕ → W →ₗ[F] W) (b : ℕ → W),
      (fixed = true → ∀ j p w, ask j p w = mix w (ix (2*j.val))) ∧
      k ≤ Nat.card {w : W // out name c w = A (run ask w) w + b (run ask w)}) ↔ k ≤ 2^h*zeros

changed.title: A planar three-matching family has full zero-pin query rank on every split of its boundary terminals at one common price vector
changed.statement:
∀ k : ℕ, 0 < k →
  let n := 8*k^2
  let I := Fin n
  let V := Bool × I
  let T := Fin (2*k)
  let E := Fin 3 × I
  ∃ (σ τ : Equiv.Perm I) (pin : T → V) (z : E → ℕ),
    let dest := fun e : E => if e.1 = 0 then e.2 else if e.1 = 1 then σ e.2 else τ e.2
    let arc := fun (a b : V) => !a.1 && b.1 &&
      (decide (a.2 = b.2) || decide (σ a.2 = b.2) || decide (τ a.2 = b.2))
    let link := fun a b => arc a b || arc b a
    let G := Option V
    let rim := fun a : V => decide (∃ j, pin j = a)
    let inc := fun (x y : G) => x.elim (y.elim false rim) (fun a => y.elim (rim a) (link a))
    Function.Injective pin ∧ (∀ i j : V, Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b => link a b = true) i j) ∧
    (∃ (l : ℕ) (src dst : Fin l → G) (rot rev : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)),
      Function.Injective (fun d => (src d,dst d)) ∧
      (∀ a b : G, inc a b = true ↔ ∃ d, src d = a ∧ dst d = b) ∧
      (∀ d, src (rev d) = dst d ∧ dst (rev d) = src d ∧ src (rot d) = src d) ∧
      (∀ a b, src a = src b → ∃ j : ℕ, (rot^j) a = b) ∧
      let walk := fun a : Fin l => rot (rev a)
      let faces := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin l)).image (fun a =>
        (Finset.range l).image (fun j => walk^[j] a))
      2*(2*n+1) + 2*faces.card = 4+l) ∧
    (∀ e, 2 ≤ z e ∧ z e ≤ (3*n+1)*8^(2*k+1)) ∧
    ∀ A : Finset T,
      let mat : Matrix (Finset T) (Finset T) ℚ := fun P Q =>
        ∑ x : V → Bool, if (∀ j ∈ A ∩ P, x (pin j) = false) ∧
            (∀ j ∈ Q, j ∉ A → x (pin j) = false) then
          ∏ e : E, (if x (false,e.2) = x (true,dest e) then 1 else (z e : ℚ)) else 0
      Matrix.rank mat = 2^(min A.card (2*k-A.card))

changed.title: Fixed-parameter circuits recover parallel edge counts from spin masses near the two-ninths error threshold
changed.statement:
∃ C A : ℕ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ t k s : ℕ, 2 ≤ t → 0 < k → 3 ≤ s →
  let T := Fin t
  let V := Option (T × Bool)
  let Pair := {p : T × T // p.1 < p.2}
  let E := Fin 3 × T
  let Mask := T → Fin 3
  let tail := fun e : E => if e.1 = 0 then some (e.2,false) else (none : V)
  let head := fun e : E => some (e.2,decide (e.1 ≠ 1))
  let weight := fun (g : Option Pair) (e : E) (diff : Bool) =>
    if e.1 = 0 then diff.toNat else if e.1 = 2 then 1 else
    if g.elim false (fun p => decide (p.val.1 = e.2 ∨ p.val.2 = e.2)) then
      (if diff then 1 else 3) else (2 : ℕ)
  let obs := fun (g : Option Pair) (p : Mask) =>
    ∑ x : V → Bool, if (∀ i : T, p i = 0 ∨ p i = (if x (some (i,false)) then 2 else 1)) ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun e : E => x (tail e) ≠ x (head e))).card = 2*t then
      ∏ e : E, weight g e (xor (x (tail e)) (x (head e))) else 0

  let Model := Fin k → Option Pair
  let read := fun (G : Model) (p : Mask) => ∏ l, obs (G l) p
  let W := k*(2*t+2)+1
  ∃ (d : ℕ) (batch : Fin d → Mask) (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit)
    (out : Pair → Fin (k+1) → Fin (2+d*(W+1)+g.size)),
    0 < d ∧ d ≤ C*(k+1)^2*s^3*(1+Nat.log 2 ((k+1)*s))*(1+Nat.log 2 t) ∧
    g.size ≤ (t+2)^A*(k+s+2)^(A*(k+1)) ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (2+d*(W+1)) g ∧
    (∀ gate ∈ g.gates, ((gate.op = .and ∨ gate.op = .or) ∧ gate.inputs.length = 2) ∨
      (gate.op = .not ∧ gate.inputs.length = 1)) ∧
    ∀ (G : Model), (∀ i, read G (batch i) < 2^W) ∧
      ∀ (y : Fin d → Option ℕ),

        let err := (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => y i ≠ none ∧ y i ≠ some (read G (batch i)))).card
        9*s*(2*err+lost) < (4*s-9)*d →
        let bits := (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin d => (y i).isSome ::
          List.ofFn (fun j : Fin W => ((y i).getD 0).testBit j.val))).flatten
        ∀ (e : Pair) (m : Fin (k+1)), (g.wires ([false,true] ++ bits)).getD (out e m).val false =
          decide ((Finset.univ.filter (fun l => G l = some e)).card = m.val)
